leads.title: Sumter woman used torch lighter to start house fire during domestic dispute, deputies say
leads.summary: A Sumter woman faces an arson charge after allegedly using a torch lighter to set fire to the home where she lived, deputies say.

leads.title: 1 hurt, 4 homes damaged after Conway-area fire
leads.summary: HORRY COUNTY, S.C. (WBTW) -- One person suffered minor injuries after a two-alarm house fire in the Conway area, Horry County Fire Rescue said Monday afternoon. leads.title: Charleston Fire Department names new Emergency Manager
leads.summary: CHARLESTON, S.C. (WCBD) - The Charleston Fire Department (CFD) announced it has selected Jon Stewart as the new Emergency Manager within the Fire Marshal's Office and to lead citywide emergency preparedness efforts.
